prices_raw.csv: Daily adjusted closing prices from Tiingo for all 18 assets. Index=date, columns=tickers, units=USD.
daily_log_returns.csv: Daily log returns: ln(P_t/P_{t-1}). Index=date, columns=tickers.
monthly_returns.csv: Monthly total returns compounded from daily. Index=month-end date.
portfolio_daily_returns.csv: Equal-weight portfolio daily log return. Weight per asset = 0.0556.
portfolio_ewma_vol.csv: Portfolio EWMA annualised vol series. λ=0.94.
macro_series.csv: Six FRED macro series + yield curve inversion flag.
macro_stationarity.csv: ADF test results. Non-stationary series must be differenced in Phase 4.
return_diagnostics.csv: Per-asset: mean, std, skewness, kurtosis, JB test.
data_quality_report.csv: Per-asset: missing count, outlier count, zero-return count.
metadata.json: All project parameters. Loaded by every phase.
